lines.text: Mayong gab-e, to. Pasensya gd sa distorbo. Amo ni ang balay ni Carmen?
lines.translation: (Good evening, young man. Sorry for the late notice, but is this the residence of Carmen?)

lines.text: Tinawo ko gali ni Boss Pedro. May utang di si Carmen Isidro sang P69,420.67. Lapit na isa ka bulan nga wala siya kabayad.
lines.translation: (I was tasked by Boss Pedro. It says here that Carmen Isidro owes us P69,420.67, and she missed a month's worth of payment.)

no.text: Basi sa piyak balay sa nong.
no.translation: (She probably lives at that other house.)

lines.text: Seryoso ni bala to kag kadako gid sang utang nyo. Kung nde maka pakita si mama mo, ikaw atubang sang iya utang. Mabalik kami bwas. Indi pag hulta si boss mismo ang makadto sa inyo.
lines.translation: (This is a serious matter, young man. And it is a hefty sum. If your mother is unavailable, you deal with it. We'll return tomorrow. Don't make this complicated. You don't want the Boss to visit you himself.)

lines_positive.text: Mayong gab-e noy. Ari ko di gale para sa utang ni nanay mo.
lines_positive.translation: (Good evening. I'm here for your mother's debt.)

lines_positive.text: Si ano bala... Si 'Nay Carmen.
lines_positive.translation: (Yes... your mother Carmen.)

lines_positive.text: Pwede ka man kahulog danay biskan ginagmay lang noy. Dako dako gd sang utang ya pero mabaton kami P200 subong ah.
lines_positive.translation: (You can pay just a small amount right now. Your mother's debt is very big but we will settle with a small amount of P200 right now.)

no.translation: (It's really impossible to pay right now.)

lines_positive.text: Salamat gid noy. Markahan ko lang di.
lines_positive.translation: (Thanks. I'll just mark it right here.)

lines_negative.text: Oo, 69 tawsan.
lines_negative.translation: (Yes. 69 thousand.)

lines_negative.text: Di nyo bala pwede pag-lagyuhan ang inyo utang noy. Dako gid na nga perwisyo sa inyo.
lines_negative.translation: (You can't just run away from your debts, young man. It will just be a thorn on your side.)

no.translation: (It's really impossible to pay right now.)

lines_negative.text: Ikaw bahala. Pero indi ka namon pag untatan. Mangamote ka gid sang interes.
